title: Legacy Font Mapping
description: Schema for the JSON files inside source_json/legacy/*.json.

glyphs.description: Maps each SMuFL glyph name to the legacy codepoints that carry it.

fontMetadata.description: Font-level facts about the legacy font as a whole.

fontType.description: How the font is used in a score. 'engraving' fonts are placed in the score as notation; 'text' fonts are set inline with running text, such as chord symbols, metronome marks, and expression text.

fontStyle.description: What the font looks like: 'engraved' imitates traditional plate engraving, 'handwritten' imitates manuscript. This is independent of fontType, since a font may be handwritten and still be set inline with text. Recorded from knowledge of the font rather than measured, as the distinction is an editorial judgement about appearance and no geometric property separates the two reliably.

smuflSuccessorFont.description: Name of the SMuFL font that supersedes this legacy font, for a client substituting a modern face. A 'text' font names a SMuFL text face where one exists. null means no successor has been established; clients should fall back to their own default rather than guess.

successorNotes.description: Why smuflSuccessorFont holds the value it does. Expected whenever the value is null or the choice is not obvious.

staffSpacesPerEm.description: How many staff spaces one em spans in this legacy font. A conforming SMuFL font is 4.0 by definition, so a client converts a point size with `smuflPointSize = legacyPointSize * (4.0 / staffSpacesPerEm)`. null means the font opts out: its point size has no staff-relative meaning and clients must not emit a size for glyphs mapped from it.

sizeNotes.description: Why staffSpacesPerEm holds the value it does. Required in practice whenever the value is null or was inferred rather than measured.

legacyCodepoints.description: Legacy font codepoints (decimal or C-style hex).

nameIsMakeMusic.description: Whether Finale treated the glyph name as MakeMusic-specific.

smuflFontName.description: Name of the SMuFL font that supplied the optional glyph.

xOffset.description: Finale-specific positional value in thousandths of an em, preserved from the original MakeMusic data. Not consumed by the generator and not exposed in the API; kept only so the information is not lost.

yOffset.description: Finale-specific positional value in thousandths of an em, preserved from the original MakeMusic data. Not consumed by the generator and not exposed in the API; kept only so the information is not lost.

alternate.description: True if this entry intentionally differs from the canonical glyphnames mapping.
